itineraries.title: Dubai 2027
itineraries.description: Discover Dubai through a guided city tour featuring photo stops and drives past landmarks including Dubai Frame, Palm Jumeirah and the Museum of the Future. The itinerary also includes an evening dhow cruise, visits to Burj Khalifa and Global Village, and a choice between the Dolphin Show and the Museum of the Future, subject to the stated supplement and advance-booking conditions. An Abu Dhabi tour is offered as an alternative to a leisure day at an additional supplement, with listed stops including BAPS Temple, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Ferrari World and the Corniche. The journey also features Miracle Garden, a desert safari with listed camp activities, and time for shopping before departure.

itineraries.title: Tamil Nadu Through the Five Senses
itineraries.tag-line: Travel Beyond the Ordinary. Experience the Extraordinary.
itineraries.description: Discover Tamil Nadu through its timeless temples, magnificent heritage, living craft traditions, and vibrant harvest celebrations. From the sacred banks of the Kaveri and the artistic treasures of Thanjavur to the warmth of a village Pongal celebration, the cool mountain landscapes of Kodaikanal, the ancient stories of Keeladi, and the distinctive flavours of Chettinad and Madurai, this thoughtfully curated journey invites you to experience the soul of Tamil Nadu through all five senses. See its architectural wonders, taste its regional delicacies, touch its traditional crafts, hear its stories and musical traditions, and feel the warmth of its people and living culture.

itineraries.title: Kashmir Winter Packages
itineraries.description: Discover the enchanting beauty of Kashmir on a 5-night, 6-day journey through snow-capped mountains, tranquil lakes, lush valleys, and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes. From the scenic charm of Srinagar and the golden meadows of Sonamarg to the mountain adventures of Gulmarg, the serene beauty of Pahalgam, and a magical houseboat stay on Dal Lake, experience the timeless allure of paradise on Earth.
